jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description: About AMINI AMINI advises, designs, and delivers across strategy, infrastructure, and AI. We work directly with clients on technology decisions, architecture, projects, and AI implementations - and we ship our own products alongside client work (andock.app, mrkr.app, it-provider.ch, and others). We’re an ambitious team based in Zug and Zurich - this is your chance to build something remarkable together with a leading edge team. The Role We’re looking for an AI-Native Design Engineer who treats interfaces as a craft - the place where business intent, technical constraints, and usability meet. You’ll own the design and frontend implementation of experiences across our own products and selected client projects. This is not a pure design role and not a pure engineering role. It’s for someone who moves fluidly between both and ships things that feel considered, polished, and inevitable. Design taste is obviously a must in this role. You’ll work closely with architects, solution engineers, and client teams. You’ll have real ownership and a direct path from idea to production. What You’ll Do Design and build production interfaces for our products and client solutions (AI tools, agent interfaces, dashboards, internal systems, analytics products, etc.). Own the full loop: understand the problem, explore concepts, prototype, implement in code, ship, and iterate. Contribute to and evolve design systems, component libraries, and interaction patterns that raise the quality bar across everything we build. Bring strong visual and interaction craft: motion, depth, clarity, and restraint - while orchestrating AI agents in writing frontend code. Collaborate directly with the team and clients. Present work, gather feedback, and make decisions. Help shape product direction on our own ventures, not just execute specs. What We’re Looking For A strong portfolio of shipped work that demonstrates both design taste and engineering ability. Experience with AI/agent engineering, design systems

jobs.title: Founding UI/UX Artist, Unannounced Game
jobs.description: This is your opportunity to join a small group of obsessed game makers, building an ambitious mobile game focused on collection and social. As our founding UI & UX Artist you will be the owner of the entire UX structure at a high level, down to the UI art pixels in detail. You will work intimately with engineers, artists, designers from the vision level, down to the hands on implementation. Not settling for industry good, but pioneering new UX paradigms, head turning UI art style and hyper juicy interactions. We’re looking for someone who is passionate about their craft, making social game experiences, and also a student of behavioral psychology. Someone who plays games seriously, but understands that at least a bit of silliness is needed for success. Someone who thinks about all the edge cases, but knows doing it alone, will always leave blind spots. If you feel you have great ability, a growth mindset, and high ambition, then join us at the start of our journey! Side quest: Read this new page about making new games at Supercell. Would Be Nice

You'll work directly with our Design Lead, engineers, and founders. What you design this week can ship next week. What You'll Actually Do Own UI/UX design for entire product areas across web, iOS, and Android. Take features from user research through wireframes through polished UI through shipped product. Build and extend our design system — we care about consistency at scale. Collaborate daily with engineering to make sure what ships matches what you designed. Run usability tests with real doctors and patients, then iterate based on what you learn. Present your work, defend your decisions, and stay open when you're wrong. What We Offer Remote-friendly (distributed across the Philippines) Health insurance Flexible hours Paid leave (sick, vacation, maternity/paternity, bereavement) Real ownership — your name is on the work, and the work matters How to Apply Send your portfolio showing your process, not just final screens. Tell us which of our products (SeriousMD or NowServing) you'd want to work on first, and why.
